method: idle-vs-active DC bench supply (RS PRO RS-3005P) delta, CV mode
measurement_level: system (Pi 5 + M.2 HAT+ + AKD1000 card + GPIO fan combined, not chip-isolated)
notes: Constant-voltage mode confirmed throughout (C.V indicator, no C.C trip). A 5V/0.12A cooling fan is soldered directly to the GPIO header and runs continuously; its constant draw appears in both idle and active readings and cancels in the delta.
